about: The falsifier: an alias that resolves to no blob, handed to the runtime anyway. With runner/host standing only as target text in bound's own lock, a blob run found no signed line, joined an empty id onto its own directory and started node on .bound/cas/blobs. Every capsule it asked answered nothing, and a render would have written each page without the regions its capsules own.
